Last Updated: August 2026

At Saint Roman, operated by ANNORIA HOUSE OF BRANDS Private Limited, we understand that sometimes orders need to be cancelled. This Cancellation Policy is part of our broader Cancellation, Return & Exchange Policy — please read it below.

1. Before dispatch

  • Orders can be canceled directly via the App or Website within 2 hours of placement, or until the order status changes to "Dispatched."
  • A 100% instant refund will be issued for prepaid orders.

2. After dispatch

  • Once an order has been dispatched from our fulfillment center, it cannot be canceled.
  • You may refuse delivery when the courier partner arrives, and a refund will be initiated after the shipment returns to our facility (minus applicable RTO freight charges).

For any cancellation queries, see our full Cancellation, Return & Exchange Policy or contact us at support@saintromanfashion.com.
